title: Google Research wants AI agents judged by the context of their actions
teaser: Google Research is making a case for judging AI agents by the context they act in, not just by the data they handle. A report prepared by more than 50 researchers and industry specialists argues that privacy and security controls must account for who is involved, what information is at stake and what an agent is about to do. The proposal is a response to systems that plan on the fly, use outside tools and carry out long tasks with less direct oversight.
